notes.title: Public Demo Bug Patch #2
notes.notes:
The circle part of the fill bar was staying the same size despite paint still being drained
 Fixed walking on surfaces not being limited a maximum angle, the player can no longer walk up mountains sorry.
 The Toppled Tree Shrine area now requires half as much area to be filled before the key is spawned, as intended.

notes.title: Public Demo Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
Removed invert material from first key lock for consistency
 Doubled the paint regen rate when not painting
 Exiting the menu default to the upgrade menu rather than maintaining last menu
 Moved the "Quit Game" to make it harder to accidentally click when closing menu
 All pause menu pages now maintain all pause menu buttons
 Respawning via the menu button no longer breaks the player controller when pressing before collecting green paint

notes.title: Public Demo Bug Patch #1
notes.notes:
Fixed tunnel that gets you through the mountain not being paintable.
 Book stacks now splash instead of play celebration jingle.
 Flags now splash instead of play celebration jingle.
 There should be less clipping on environment collision not meant to be traversable.
 Jumping cannot clip through ceilings any longer.
 Continue button on initial settings menu can now be clicked on the arrow visual.

Known Issue:

 You can now walk up just about any steepness of a hill including the mountain. Oops.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
A selection of fixes for common issues with loading

 Loading scene now activates sooner when starting game from main menu
 Fix issue where load percentage wasn't displaying properly
 Added a spinning paint drop so you can see the game is working more easily while loading
 When the player is loaded in, there is now a load percentage displayed and the spinning drop to display progress
 Swapped load order for levels to speed up initial load

Misc Additional Fixes:

 Fixed the plank to get on the boat at the end being very narrow and at an odd angle
 Smoothed out blob renderer so that it has less of a performance hit when on screen

notes.title: Demo Major Update #1
notes.notes:
New Features

 Settings selection on Launch (Language, Resolution, Full Screen, Colorblind Modes, Volume)
 Added fonts for each of the 17 supported languages
 Added translation captions to the intro cinematic
 Dialogue falls back to english pending translation
 Mouse Wheel Icon now displays next to selection prompt for options to make it more clear how to select


Misc Fixes

 Added credit for the voice actor and writer for the intro cinematic
 Fixed Friendly Orb name display
 Fixed text for relic collections for some relics
 Added dialogue options padding on the left to stop render clipping
 Made button menu font style more clear
 Moved down intro video captions
 Removed several enemies in locations that were oppressive and not interesting
 Fixed Vector UI rendering over Raster UI (allows button propts to no longer be blocked by some other UI elements)


Known Issues

 Russian and Ukrainian Missing Characters
 Traditional Chinese Missing Characters
 Character names are not translated
 Dialogue is not translated as the dialogue is not locked for the demo, this will be translated by the 24th

notes.title: Mini-Patch for Press Access Tomorrow
notes.notes:
Just a few fixes and additions for polishing the experience:

 Added story teaser as a skippable intro to the game
 Fixed issue with color blindness drop down and resolution drop down
 UI is now render in such a way to account for the full range of FOV options allowed
 Fixed the fill rate on some objects in the early part of the game
 Fixed some loud audio in the environment such as the waterfall
 Reworked some areas that were disconnected spacial to just be part of different areas
 Adjusted fill needs to key the keys in areas affected by the above
 Made the Librarian's dialogue progress as expected
 Fixed some UI clarity issues that also contributed to abnormally bad UI jitter (some jitter still remains at low frame rates)
 Alt + Tab no longer can get the pause menu mouse state locked invisible
 Fixed most audio pops from painting on surfaces of different materials (some edge cases still remain which I am investigating)
 Only show PC controls in the settings menu and fixed some icons that were not showing

Okay... maybe this was a lot. But that's probably a good thing!

notes.title: Pre-Release Demo
notes.notes:
Honestly too many changes to count but basically the biggest ones are:

Characters added that you can have conversations with
Areas now spawn keys and those key are use to unblock specific progress points
Added a tutorial level to showcase the basics in a less cluttered way
Removed a lot of enemies so only specific areas have those kinds of dangers
Abilities now must be discovered in the map rather than unlocked
Added some micro quests that you can get from characters
Rebalanced paint use, ink flask charges, blobs, and the fill rate of many objects to feel better
Tons and tons of bug fixes


This is just what I could squeeze in the scope up to the 14th since that's when journalist access to the event begins. I will keep refining and fixing bugs up to the 24th when the event begins!

notes.title: A Series of Polish Changes
notes.notes:
This demo is not meaningfully different content wise than the previous, but a lot has been reworked.

The last demo added several new mechanics like the sword and the bow abilities, that are removed for now and should be available from additional content being added.

Key Changes:

 More auto-filling objects around
 More sources of paint refill
 Running out of paint doesn't kill you
 When low on paint your first health bar will regenerate when not painting
 Added relaxing soundtrack
 New upgrade system paid for with the crystals you find in the map
 Streamlined level - Removed a lot of ancillary areas and kept it to one key loop
 Rebalanced how quickly things fill with paint and made paint drain much more slowly
 Make the player faster
 Completely reworked the character controller
 Added more feedback when rewards are given or when things are filled
 Added a state for filled in objects to show when they are "Complete" (they fill white)
 Added stationary enemies to add some tension and threat of death in distinct areas


One thing I had hoped to have completed by now was dialogue with characters. I went down a route with trying to add too many new things rather than focusing on getting that up and running. I have since re-prioritized.

The next build will be a true vertical slice in this first area, even adding things that are meant to be added in later levels, with the hopes of that being the Next Fest demo (in February).

Thanks so much for playing and don't forget to "Press F6 to submit feedback"!

notes.title: Playtesting Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Additional features:

 Rather than ending abruptly, the brush will not arc down to the ground if there's nothing close enough for it to paint on
 Left Control now locks the paint brush to the center of the screen, can be toggled on and off as needed

Fixes:

 Fixed a soft lock with the lighthouse that required reloading from save to progress

Rework:

 Changed the implementation for edge of screen panning while painting
 The ramp up of camera motion is more gradual
 The distance from center screen before this kicks in is ~50% larger
 Rather than be a radius from center screen is it now based on distance to the edge of screen on each axis
 As stated above you can lock the brush to center screen if this default mode still causes any motion sickness

notes.notes: Fixed quit button on credits screen.

notes.title: Public Release Time!

The demo is now playable start to finish fully functional!

 UI bugs fixed
 Save system working perfect

 New character: "King Crystal"!
